title: Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing
alloyReason: Ti-6Al-4V ELI (Grade 23, UNS R56401) is mandated for this marine piping application where ELI elements (O <=0.13%, Fe <=0.25%) provide superior fracture toughness (KIC >100 MPa-m0.5) and fatigue resistance vs standard Grade 5. This rationale is driven by seawater strainer basket outer housing and specific design requirements.
process: Ring forging radial-axial for marine piping geometry
CNC turn-bore operation with 0.5mm corner radius
TIG welding autogenous with 0.5mm corner radius
Hydrostatic pressure test with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for seawater strainer basket application
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion under biofouling in stagnant seawater - mitigated by CP-Ti Grade 2 + ICCP system — critical for seawater strainer basket performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing suitable for Seawater strainer basket outer housing?
faq.a: Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address marine piping operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for seawater strainer basket requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. seawater strainer basket components require Heavy-duty passivation 25% HNO3 45min per ASTM B600 for maximum chloride pitting resistance in seawater — tailored for seawater strainer basket application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Seawater Strainer Housing includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet seawater strainer basket specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Strainer housing / Filter body marine piping components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
